expectations.text: Sequences the API fixes ahead of the connector build rather than alongside it or after it.

expectations.text: States that fixing the extraction API cuts build and maintenance cost on every build path simultaneously, including customers' own hand-rolled pipelines.

expectations.text: Flags offset pagination as unsafe under concurrent writes, because offsets shift under mid-scan inserts and deletes, and recommends an opaque stable cursor instead.

expectations.text: Flags that records hard-deleted past the 90-day soft-delete window are lost permanently from the extraction path.

expectations.text: Recommends a durable 'changes or deletes since <cursor>' feed as the buildable upgrade over relying on the is_active flag alone.

expectations.text: Requires the 429 response to carry Retry-After so a connector can back off programmatically.

expectations.text: Prescribes the overlap-window reconciliation pattern: persist the last cursor, re-query a small overlap window, upsert by stable key, and pair it with periodic full reconciliation.
